articles.title: Uno a uno del Atlético: Koke y Simeone no pueden irse nunca
articles.standfirst: El capitán volvió a dar su enésimo recital el día que El Cholo se convierte en el entrenador con más victorias en la historia de la Liga.
articles.summary: El capitán volvió a dar su enésimo recital el día que El Cholo se convierte en el entrenador con más victorias en la historia de la Liga.
articles.body: El Atlético firmó un plácido triunfo en su casa del Coliseum que incluso se quedó corto. Fue un espectador, muy poco trabajo, pero transmitiendo la sensación de que siempre está. Otra portería a cero camino de su séptimo Zamora. NOTA FINAL: 6 Alicató su banda con la confianza que le permite su exuberante físico. No concedió ni una al rival e incluso sacó un balón en el área en la segunda parte que podía 'meter' al Getafe en el partido. NOTA FINAL: 7 Un partido para recuperar moral. Sin ser muy académico con el balón salió airoso gracias a su contundencia en los duelos. En esa versión comedida, sí puede ser útil en la rotación. NOTA FINAL: 7 Sin hacer ruido, es una pieza indiscutible. Así evitó también un peligroso remate del Getafe aún con 0-0. Muy seguro de principio a fin. NOTA FINAL: 8 En ataque es un filón, de una de sus constantes incorporaciones nació el primer gol. Vivió en el campo rival. Y es un lanzador de penaltis como hacía tiempo no se recordaba en el Atlético. NOTA FINAL: 8 Si le respetan las lesiones, Hjulmand no tiene nada que hacer en la pelea por el 5. El ancla perfecto... y encima recuperando su antiguo oficio de 9 para castigar un error de Soria en el 0-2. Eso sí, vio una amarilla que 'obligó' al Cholo a guardarlo en el descanso. NOTA FINAL: 9 Habría que congelarlo y que no se retire nunca. Su inteligencia y criterio para ordenar el juego y a todo el equipo no se volverá a repetir. Nadie como él representa mejor los pensamientos del Cholo. Es una pareja eterna. NOTA FINAL: 9 El otro que siempre interpreta a la perfección lo que pide cada momento. Le da igual ayudar en la base que romper al espacio, determinante en cualquier caso. NOTA FINAL: 8 Un pulmón para el Atlético y un tormento para el Getafe. Hizo la vida imposible a Zaid Romero peleando balones hasta con la cara. Puede que aún siga corriendo. NOTA FINAL: 8 Más allá de su zapatazo para encarrilar el partido, alternó aceleración con pausa para marcar diferencias en el último tercio. Definitivamente, el 10 (también por su sexto gol ya y sus cuatro asistencias) que necesita el Atlético. NOTA FINAL: 9 Volvió a perdonar un mano a mano de inicio, pero se rehizo con las asistencias de los dos primeros goles, con su movilidad y con un gran disparo que exigió la mejor parada de Soria. Pese a que alargó su sequía, completó un partido para confiar en su vuelta. NOTA FINAL: 8 Aunque se situó como segunda punta, dañó con sus giros al primer toque cada vez que bajó a recibir. Regaló dos goles a Sorloth que el noruego desaprovechó. NOTA FINAL: 7 Buenos minutos para entrar en la rotación dando descansos. NOTA FINAL: 7 Tuvo dos muy claras gracias a Kang in, pero está negado: cabeceó fuera con todo a placer y luego estrelló en Soria el mano a mano. Al menos forzó el penalti del 0-3. NOTA FINAL: 5 Se jugó el partido que quiso, supo leer el riesgo de la amarilla de Cardoso y administró los esfuerzos entre medias del parón y de la Champions que asoma el miércoles... en el día que se ha convertido en la mayor leyenda de los banquillos de la Liga con sus 345 victorias. NOTA FINAL: 9

articles.title: Goles sin necesidad de goleadores
articles.standfirst: A falta de que acierten de una vez los delanteros, Baena y Johnny encarrilan ante un Getafe irreconocible el cómodo triunfo del Atlético que cierra desde el punto de penalti Grimaldo
articles.summary: A falta de que acierten de una vez los delanteros, Baena y Johnny encarrilan ante un Getafe irreconocible el cómodo triunfo del Atlético que cierra desde el punto de penalti Grimaldo
articles.body: Sin delanteros como anda, al menos en lo que a la faceta realizadora respecta, el Atlético acumula centrocampistas para dominar los partidos y sostener el tirón clasificatorio. Simeone diseñó en Getafe para ganar una especie de triángulo con Koke algo por detrás de Barrios y Johnny, pero es que Baena e incluso Julián acudían al reclamo de la combinación para crear superioridades ante un Getafe desprovisto de Carvajal a última hora y que no acabó nunca de adecuarse a las necesidades de la función. Había tenido la primera de salida, un cabezazo desviado de Azón a la salida de una falta, pero ésa fue prácticamente la única. Un equipo puede circular sin goleadores, que no sin goles. Así que Baena se ha puesto el fútbol por montera para acumular media docena de muescas en lo que va de Liga. La del Coliseum, para estrenar el marcador, llegó vía derechazo abajo y junto al poste, donde duele, tras dejada de Julián en acción que tuvo origen en una apertura del otra vez encomiable Koke. Disfrazado de pasador como andaba, La Araña topó con Soria cuando se le pidió que definiera para el segundo. En realidad tuvo dos, pero en la segunda poco se le puede reprochar, descolgada prácticamente de la escuadra por el meta local. Aún se lució el de las manoplas en otra doble, de Hancko y Le Normand, antes de estropear su velada con una pifia tremenda a la salida de un córner: ni siquiera llegaban a molestarle rivales o compañeros, pero se quedó con el molde permitiendo el rodillazo a la jaula de un Johnny cuya marca había perdido Djené. Como desde la esquina la puso Julián, vaya otra asistencia para él. En realidad ese segundo acierto visitante caía por su propio peso, ni siquiera el Getafe conseguía que el rival se sintiera como se sienten casi todos sus rivales: incómodo. Un remate envenenado de Ünal puede consignarse como ocasión azulona, pero antes de que se decretara un armisticio en forma de descanso aún llegaron las de Barrios y Baena para certificar un primer acto definitivamente dominado por un equipo al que esta vez, segunda equipación mediante, no puede adjetivarse como rojiblanco. A Bordalás no le quedaba otra que tomar medidas, después de que, entre otras cuestiones, hubiera apostado de salida por Zaid Romero en la izquierda para dar vuelo por delante a Mojica. O al menos para intentarlo, se entiende. Aparecieron Kiko Femenía y Satriano, efectivamente. Pero, aunque se supone que el míster local buscaría con ello alterar las constantes vitales del partido, lo cierto es que aquello discurrió como venía discurriendo. Casi siempre intervencionista, El Cholo también apostó por Kang-in por Johnny. O sea, un cambio ofensivo con 0-2 en el marcador. El caso es que el Atlético siguió manejando la cosa, cierto es que con alguna tendencia contemporizadora. Baena topó con Soria en la más clara, sin que en el otro área hubiera nada que llevarse a la boca. Así que Bordalás lo intentó de nuevo, esta vez con Mario y Borja Mayoral, mientras desde el otro banquillo surgían primero Mendoza y después el indescriptible Sorloth, que enseguida dejó un remate en el que la cabeza y el cuello no se pusieron de acuerdo para girar, todo ello por supuesto sin despegarse del suelo, y poco después estrelló en el portero un pelotazo que pedía cualquier otra cosa. Djené debió pensar (seguramente el único) que la tercera sería la vencida, porque le hizo penalti justo cuando armaba la pierna, aunque el ínclito don Jesús se hizo el longuis hasta que la tecnología ordenó revisión. Por supuesto la pena máxima fue para Grimaldo, carrilero de profesión, especialista en la causa. ¿Delanteros? ¿Quién necesita a esos tipos?

articles.title: Simeone: "Quiero compartir las 345 victorias con toda la gente que hay detrás, la que te acompaña"
articles.standfirst: El Cholo hizo partícipe de su hito a su familia, a los futbolistas y a sus ayudantes
articles.summary: El Cholo hizo partícipe de su hito a su familia, a los futbolistas y a sus ayudantes
articles.body: Simeone compareció tras el triunfo. Partido redondo. "Fue importante, supimos interpretar por dónde venían los goles. No pudimos cerrarlo con contundencia, pero el equipo generó. En el segundo tiempo el 0-2 era peligroso y el resultado parecía que era corto, pero cerramos un partido que era importante". Preocupación por la falta de contundencia. "No, me preocuparía más si no las tuviéramos". Récord de victorias en Liga pese a la etiqueta de defensivo. "Me gustaría ser más profundo, compartir este número, aunque no es un trofeo, con toda la gente que está detrás de estas 345 victorias. Mi mujer Carla es una fuente para que uno pueda llegar a este lugar. La gente que te acompaña, mis hijos y mis hijas, por el tiempo que les he sacado. Haber llegado a este lugar hay mucho trabajo detrás de muchos futbolistas que dieron la vida, del club... Y de los que trabajaron conmigo: El Profe, el Mono, Vizcaino, Vivas... Por eso quería ampliar a mucho más allá que explicar esa etiqueta de defensivo". Baena. "Se siente dueño del equipo, está tomando la responsabilidad que dejó Griezmann. Me pone muy contento, trabajó mucho el año pasado, vino del Villarreal, que era diferente, ni mejor ni peor, y está en un punto más alto de lo que vino". Cambio de Cardoso. "Fue mezcla de que estaba cargado y de la amarilla en un campo complicado. Jugó como venía haciendo antes de la lesión". Julián. "Siempre que está cerca del arco pensamos todos 'lo va a meter'. Acabará haciendo goles, el año pasado también tardó. Lo necesitamos, hizo un partido bárbaro, se asoció con todos y el gol llegará cuando tenga que llegar". Sexta victoria fuera. "Estamos interpretando mejor los partidos fuera de casa. Los goles te dan esa calma para continuar el partido. Veníamos de 50 minutos muy buenos con el Barcelona, fue duro el resultado y a todos los grandes de Europa les costó volver del parón. De local tienes más apoyo, pero igual que en el anterior con el Alavés, lo conseguimos".

articles.title: Danny Murphy column: Why Rio Ngumoha is Liverpool's game-changer now
articles.summary: Match of the Day pundit Danny Murphy explains how Rio Ngumoha showed everyone what he is capable of in Liverpool's 4-0 win over Manchester United.
articles.body:
Rio Ngumoha is going to be a 'wow' player for Liverpool - and he showed everyone exactly what he is already capable of in Sunday's 4-0 win over Manchester United.

He made an outstanding assist then added a fine finish, and there is much more to come. He plays without fear so he is going to score and make many more goals the same way.

Ngumoha has only just turned 18 but he is already a game-changer, someone who gets people excited because he is so hard to stop when he is one-on-one.

Of course he can frustrate you at times too, but that's what creative and explosive wingers like him do - and it's because he is so talented that everyone wants to see an end product from him every time he gets on the ball.

There were times against United when Ngumoha did not quite deliver, but he is still so young and I would much rather see players like him take too many touches - or try too many things and fail - than be afraid to try them in the first place.

So, if he runs out of play or runs into too many players at times, because teams are doubling up on him like United were, that just shows how scared they are of him.

His ability means he occupies opposition players - Youri Tielemans was always backing up Diogo Dalot on his wing to try to help him out, but that just meant United were leaving someone else free.

Sometimes it is actually harder when you are playing out wide against 10 men because you don't get the same amount of space - United were not attacking the same way they would have done with 11, and they were sitting in more.

Yes, Ngumoha ran up the odd blind alley or got outnumbered but that is always going to happen. As he learns, and gets even better, his decision-making will improve too. He will know when to try to go past people or when to find that free man instead.

But he still showed all the bravery you want from a winger against United and, when you keep trying things the way he did, something is going to come off for you.

I look at Bradley Barcola in a similar way to Ngumoha - he can be frustrating but he tries things, and can be brilliant.

For Liverpool right now, one of the biggest positives is the competition they have in wide areas, with those two plus Victor Munoz and Cody Gakpo.

There are other areas of their squad, like left-back or central midfield, where that competition needs to improve, but I don't really worry about the wide attacking areas in the same way.

Sunday was only Ngumoha's second Premier League start of the season, and his first since the opening day.

He maybe only got his chance because Gakpo has a calf problem but, when everyone is fit, it is really exciting that they will all be thinking they have to play their best to push the manager and get in the team.

'An important day for a positive mindset'

There were plenty of other positives for Liverpool , too. All in all, Sunday could not have gone much better for them.

United made a woeful start with poor concentration and mistakes which cost them but, from there, Liverpool saw the game out well.

Just because the opposition has a man sent off early on does not mean any kind of victory is a given, let alone a 4-0 win.

Look at how United's 11 men lost to City's 10 in the Manchester derby earlier this season - we've seen many times how good teams can frustrate a side with an extra player like that.

It definitely does not mean you are going to steamroller them, but Liverpool did that and made an abundance of chances to get even more goals.

Days like this are so important for building belief in all their attacking players, especially because they were playing at home, and against their big rivals.

Up until now, it had felt like Liverpool 's better days this season had come on the road, but now the pressure and expectation is off them a bit - particularly if, like Ngumoha or Florian Wirtz, you have scored and played well.

I know from experience that, the next time they go back to Anfield, they will be buzzing. You know that the fans are already with you after you've scored against United, and you feel the love a little bit more.

This is the start of a big week for Liverpool and Iraola will probably make changes against Club Brugge in Belgium on Wednesday, knowing how difficult Sunday's Merseyside derby will be.

Everton is always a tough game but I think Liverpool will enjoy their trip to Hill Dickinson Stadium, and the confidence they will have after beating United will mean they can go there with a really positive mindset.

Danny Murphy was speaking to BBC Sport's Chris Bevan.

articles.title: Who are Angie Long and Chris Long? Meet the business couple behind the Kansas City Current's rise in women's soccer
articles.summary: Angie and Chris Long built their success in the financial world, but their biggest sporting ambition took shape through women's soccer.
articles.body: Angie and Chris Long built their success in the financial world, but their biggest sporting ambition took shape through women's soccer. The Kansas City-based couple became the driving force behind the return of professional women's football to the city. Their investment helped establish the Kansas City Current and gave the club something few teams in the league had: a long-term plan backed by major infrastructure. Today, their work has placed them among the most influential ownership figures in the NWSL.Angie and Chris Long built their careers before entering women's soccerThe couple's story began at Princeton University, where they met during their college years. Angie Long grew up in Kansas City and developed a love for sports, playing golf and rugby at university. Chris Long, who came from Hazleton, Pennsylvania, played basketball for Princeton.They married in 1997, two years after graduating, and began their professional careers in finance. Both worked at JPMorgan Chase in New York. Angie later became a managing director in credit trading, while Chris went on to work at several investment firms.Their careers eventually brought them back to Kansas City in 2006. Chris founded Palmer Square Capital Management in 2009, and Angie joined the firm in 2011 as its chief investment officer. The couple built their business together before taking on a very different challenge.Their interest in women's soccer grew after watching the 2019 FIFA Women's World Cup in France. They saw an opportunity to help the sport develop and bring a professional team back to Angie's hometown.In December 2020, the Longs and former soccer player Brittany Mahomes announced their purchase of Utah Royals FC, with plans to relocate the team to Kansas City. Patrick and Brittany Mahomes later became part of the Current's ownership group.Kansas City Current's stadium investment became the Longs' biggest statementThe club began competing in 2021 and adopted the Kansas City Current name ahead of the 2022 season. But the Longs wanted to build more than a team that could compete on the pitch.They backed a $120 million investment in CPKC Stadium, which opened in 2024 as the first purpose-built stadium for a professional women's soccer team. The club also prioritised a dedicated training facility, giving its players resources designed around their needs.Angie Long explained the importance of that commitment before the club's historic championship victory.“Our building’s the first thing you see when you come into Kansas City,” Angie Long said prior to Saturday’s final. “It’s not even just a statement, it’s sort of a fact. It gives a sense of permanence to our team and relevance to our team that has been incredibly valued. And that doesn’t just show up in direct revenue, but I think it lays the foundation of value for the franchise.”The investment helped give the Current a lasting presence in the city. The club's first NWSL Championship title in November 2026 added a major sporting reward to that vision.For the Longs, the achievement represented more than a trophy. articles.title: Gil Manzano explica por qué pitó el penalti a Sorloth tras la llamada del VAR
articles.standfirst: "El defensor empuja al delantero en la zona DOGSO y le impide rematar", ha asegurado en Movistar LaLiga
articles.summary: "El defensor empuja al delantero en la zona DOGSO y le impide rematar", ha asegurado en Movistar LaLiga
articles.body: El árbitro Jesús Gil Manzano analizó en los micrófonos de Movistar LaLiga el encuentro que dirigió en el Coliseum entre Getafe y Atlético. Y una de las jugadas a las que se refirió fue al penalti que señaló a favor de los de Simeone en la recta final del encuentro. Una acción entre Djené y Sorloth, que además significó la expulsión del jugador azulón. El penalti sobre Sorloth: "En el campo hemos valorado la jugada y pensamos que prácticamente no existía intensidad, pero cuando nos han llamado los compañeros del VAR, evidentemente, hemos visto que en la acción hay una causa-efecto. El defensor empuja al delantero en la zona DOGSO y le impide rematar y nos tenemos que ir al penalti". Como el penalti que le pitaron al Atlético ante el Villarreal: "Intentamos la unificación de criterios y tratamos de que en diferentes campos se tome la misma decisión con la misma acción". El partido: "Ha sido un partido bastante tranquilo. Han jugado con intensidad, pero los dos equipos han respetado un fair play muy bueno, todo correcto". Hubo una rectificación de un córner: "Es una de las nuevas modificaciones. El VAR puede entrar si se ha sancionado un saque de esquina y es erróneo. El balón ya había salido, por lo que el córner finalmente no se ha producido".

articles.title: Tennessee Fined by SEC After Fans Threw Golf Balls, Mustard Bottles onto Field vs. Lane Kiffin, LSU
articles.summary: Tennessee fans celebrated their win over LSU on Saturday by throwing golf balls and mustard bottles at their former head coach, Lane Kiffin, and the move will cost the university a pretty penny.
articles.body:
Tennessee fans celebrated their win over LSU on Saturday by throwing golf balls and mustard bottles at their former head coach, Lane Kiffin, and the move will cost the university a pretty penny.

Tennessee has been fined $250,000 by the SEC on Sunday.

The mustard bottles and golf balls were a callback to the 2021 game between the Vols and Ole Miss, which was Kiffin's first trip to Knoxville as a head coach since leaving abruptly after the 2009 season.

During that game, fans were upset by a call by an official, and they threw trash and debris onto the field, leading to some viral moments involving a golf ball and a mustard bottle.

The fine on Sunday marks the second time Tennessee has had to pay after a win, as the school was also fined $500,000 after fans stormed the field following a win over rival Alabama in October.

The Vols' win over LSU helped them improve to 9-2 and bolstered their College Football Playoff resume. Kiffin and the Tigers, meanwhile, dropped to 6-5 with the loss as his first year in Baton Rouge continues to get worse.

articles.title: Raiders show heart but cannot capitalize on opportunities in loss to Broncos
articles.summary: DENVER—What was looking like a day to remember for Fernando Mendoza and the Las Vegas Raiders quickly soured in the thin Denver air.
articles.body:
DENVER—What was looking like a day to remember for Fernando Mendoza and the Las Vegas Raiders quickly soured in the thin Denver air.

Even on a day with several positive developments, mistakes undid the Raiders in their 38-24 loss to the Denver Broncos on Sunday.

The early schedule for Mendoza's first career starts has been far from a cakewalk, but the first overall pick has done well in cementing himself as the starting quarterback of the present and future in Las Vegas.

Against Denver, Mendoza showed improvement over his first start against the Seattle Seahawks, throwing for 267 yards and three touchdowns. With no Brock Bowers in the lineup as he recovers from his ankle injury he sustained against Seattle, Mendoza found excellent chemistry with Ashton Jeanty (five receptions for a game-high 90 yards and a touchdown) and Jack Bech (game-high eight receptions for a career-high 88 yards and a touchdown).

The improved passing attack also coincided with one of the best rushing days the Raiders have had since Week One against the Miami Dolphins, with Jeanty, Mendoza and Mike Washington Jr. collectively averaging six yards per carry for 143 total rushing yards.

However, the issues with the offense are not yet completely fixed, highlighted by Mendoza's interception to Ja'Quan McMillian that iced the game in favor of the Broncos.

The offensive line struggled once again to keep pressure from getting to Mendoza, as the rookie was sacked five times for a total of 11 in the first two starts. The rookie also saw six passes get batted down at the line of scrimmage.

Another point of emphasis was Mendoza not yet getting chemistry down with his veteran receivers. Despite 15 combined targets going towards Tre Tucker and Jalen Nailor, they only recorded three receptions between them, indicating the need to continue developing the execution on offense. However, Nailor did have two touchdowns that were wiped out by penalties, so there is at least something to build off of.

Meanwhile, the defense continued to have its struggles, particularly in containing the run.

Not to be outdone by Mendoza, Broncos rookie running back Jonah Coleman solidified his place in the backfield with a tremendous performance. Leading Denver with 24 carries, Coleman rumbled for 111 yards and three rushing touchdowns in one of the best outings by a rookie this season.

Also doing the Raiders in were nine penalties worth 63 yards, as well as two blocked punts from AJ Cole.

With the Raiders sitting at 4-7, they will need to make a mad dash to remain in the hunt for a playoff spot, and the newly-flexed Sunday Night Football matchup against the Cleveland Browns next week has become a must-win to have any postseason aspirations heading into their bye week.

articles.title: 49ers’ Colton McKivitz carted off after gruesome leg injury on 'Sunday Night Football'
articles.summary: Latest updates after 49ers offensive linemen Colton McKivitz suffered a gruesome leg injury in the team's "Sunday Night Football" game vs Vikings.
articles.body:
The San Francisco 49ers lost their starting right tackle Colton McKivitz to a serious-looking injury during their Week 11 " Sunday Night Football " game against the Minnesota Vikings .

McKivitz was injured after blocking on a Christian McCaffrey run in the latter half of the second quarter. The 30-year-old tackle was rolled up in a pile as McCaffrey was tackled and as McKivitz came out of the pile, his left foot was facing the wrong direction.

McKivitz's 49ers teammates were immediately upset looking at the tackle's injury. Christian McCaffrey fell to a knee looking at him while Trent Williams was shown on the broadcast looking dismayed, and he forcibly spiked his helmet into the ground.

McKivitz was quickly tended to by medical staff on the field and was carted into the locker room as a result of his injury. Swing tackle Vederian Lowe checked into the game to replace him.

This story will be updated as more information becomes available.

articles.title: Khalid Jamil should know his XI by now: Bhaichung Bhutia
articles.summary: MUMBAI: Former India captain Bhaichung Bhutia did not mince words while assessing India coach Khalid Jamil’s tenure, which has produced just two wins in
articles.body: MUMBAI: Former India captain Bhaichung Bhutia did not mince words while assessing India coach Khalid Jamil’s tenure, which has produced just two wins in 17 matches since he took charge in Aug 2025. India’s recent 3-0 and 5-0 defeats against New Zealand have only intensified the scrutiny on the coach, with the national team having lost seven of its 10 matches this year.Bhutia also believes Jamil needs to take a harder stand with All India Football Federation (AIFF) if he is serious about turning around the national team’s fortunes, questioning both the coach’s preparedness and his willingness to fight for what he needs to succeed.“After seven friendlies, if Jamil doesn’t know his first eleven, it’s a very, very sorry state then,” Bhutia said, pointing out that international friendlies are primarily meant to help a coach settle on his preferred combination, formation and playing style.Bhutia felt Jamil had been fortunate to get as many as seven friendlies, considering international coaches often have to make do with just two or three preparatory games before major tournaments.“Friendlies are there to set up your team, to know which is your team, what formation to play with and what your first XI is. No international coach gets more than two orthree friendlies to play and prepare for a tournament. Khalid has got seven already. And after seven, if he still has not been able to set his team, it’s sad,” Bhutia said.Bhutia, who ruled out standing for AIFF president elections, also said Jamil must be prepared to challenge the federation.“If he can’t be strong enough to say to the federation, ‘I need this’, and be flexible with the federation, then you’re just taking the job for the sake of getting a job.
